channel.name: Pixel Science
channel.description: Science explained with precision and wonder: space, physics, biology and the natural world.
channel.tagline: Science for people who never stopped asking why.

audience.what_they_know: Remembers school science but not the vocabulary; loves scale and extremes.
audience.what_they_want: The mechanism behind the fact, and a sense of how big or small it really is.

writing.style: Explanation driven by scale, comparison and surprise
writing.complexity: Clear but not simplified beyond accuracy
writing.person: first person plural with direct questions
avoid: Precise-sounding numbers that no source supports
False balance between scientific consensus and fringe belief
prefer: Scale comparisons the viewer can picture
Naming the mechanism, not just the effect
Explicitly flagging uncertainty and data quality

video.hook_style: Open with a scale shock, then reveal the mechanism
video.ending_style: Return to the opening comparison and update the viewer's mental model

visuals.motion_style: Smooth orbital camera moves and slow rotations
visuals.lighting: High dynamic range, single dominant key light, deep but readable shadows
visuals.texture: Fine particulate detail, realistic lens behaviour, no plastic sheen
avoid_visuals: Space scenes where objects are implausibly close together
Anatomical imagery that is not anatomically plausible
Diagram text that is unreadable at phone size

audio.mixing_style: Narration forward, wide but restrained sound bed
audio.notes: Use silence deliberately before a key reveal.
